//: Type-checks the files that are neither shipped `src/` nor tests — the Prisma layer and
the scripts — which `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json` never examined
The blind spot this closes, concretely: `prisma/seed.ts` read
`universe.attribution?.creators?.director?.join(' ')` and would have thrown at runtime
when #148 made `creators` person-keyed. `npm run typecheck` (src + tests), `npm run
lint` (`eslint src`) and `npx jest` all stayed green; the break was found by grepping
for the field. The same applies to every `.ts` under `scripts/`.
`rootDir` is `.` rather than `src` for the same reason `tsconfig.test.json` sets it:
`prisma/` and `scripts/` are outside `src`, and inheriting `rootDir: src` makes TS6059
a build-layout complaint in every file. There is no `outDir` because this project is
only ever used with `--noEmit`; the shipped build stays `tsconfig.json`.
`.js` scripts under `scripts/` are still unchecked here. They run under `node --test`
and `tsc` would need `allowJs` + `checkJs` to see them; that is its own change, not
Test files are excluded: they are `tsconfig.test.json`'s job, and including them here
would need the jest types twice over for no additional coverage.
